turns.said: Hello. How do I register for a TIN number with URA?
assistant:
Happy to help you register for a TIN!

To register for a TIN with U R A in Uganda: 1. Visit the official U R A web portal 2. Navigate to eServices TIN Registration 3. Complete the online application form and submit.
Are you registering as an individual (requires your National ID/NIN) or an organisation (requires Certificate of Incorporation)?

turns.said: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
assistant:
The standard rate of Value Added Tax (VAT) is 18 percent, for the 2026 to 2027 financial year. Value Added Tax is charged at 18 percent on taxable supplies of goods and services; VAT-registered businesses collect it from customers and remit it to U R A. - Statutory Basis: Value Added Tax Act

That comes from the official U R A 2026 to 2027 rate table. Would you like more detail?
